st: Mix [[2.5 cups]] flour and [[0.5 tsp]] salt in a bowl. Add [[3 tbsp]] olive oil, 1 egg and enough warm water, about [[0.5 cup]], to make a soft dough.
Knead 5 minutes until smooth, cover, and rest 30 minutes.
Heat [[2 tbsp]] olive oil in a pan and cook the chopped chard 5 minutes until wilted. Cool, then squeeze out all the water and chop finely.
Mix the chard with [[1 cup]] ricotta, [[0.5 cup]] Parmesan, 2 eggs, [[0.5 tsp]] salt, [[0.5 tsp]] pepper and [[0.25 tsp]] nutmeg.
Roll the dough very thin on a floured surface and cut into 3 inch circles.
Put a heaped spoon of filling on half of each circle, fold over, and press the edges firmly with a fork to seal.
Heat [[3 cups]] oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry in small batches for 3 minutes per side until puffed and golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm.
Whisk [[1.5 cups]] chickpea flour with [[1.5 cups]] lukewarm water, [[0.75 tsp]] salt and [[2 tbsp]] olive oil until completely smooth.
Let the batter rest on the counter 30 minutes. Skim off any foam.
Place a 12 inch cast-iron skillet in the oven and heat it to 475°F (245°C) for 10 minutes.
Carefully add [[2 tbsp]] olive oil to the hot pan and swirl to coat.
Pour in the batter. Scatter the onion slices and [[1 tsp]] rosemary on top.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes until the edges are crisp and the top is spotted brown.
Brush with [[1 tbsp]] olive oil, grind pepper on top, and slice into wedges. Eat right away.

ing: peeled and chopped, or 1 can crushed
st: Soak the dried cod in cold water for 24 to 48 hours in the fridge, changing the water 4 times. For salt cod, soak 24 hours. Drain and cut into large chunks, removing bones and skin.
Heat [[0.25 cup]] olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook the onions for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic for 1 minute, then pour in [[0.5 cup]] wine and boil 2 minutes.
Stir in the tomatoes, [[1 tbsp]] tomato paste, the bay leaves, thyme and [[0.5 tsp]] pepper. Simmer 15 minutes.
Add the potatoes and the cod. Add enough water to nearly cover. Cover and simmer gently 40 minutes.
Add [[0.75 cup]] olives and simmer 15 more minutes until the cod flakes and the sauce is thick.
Discard the bay leaves and thyme stems, sprinkle with [[0.25 cup]] parsley, and serve with bread.
Mix [[3 cups]] flour, [[2 tsp]] yeast and [[1 tsp]] salt. Add [[1 cup]] warm water and [[2 tbsp]] olive oil and knead 8 minutes until smooth.
Cover and let rise 1 hour until doubled.
Meanwhile, heat [[2 tbsp]] olive oil in a large pan. Add the sliced onions, [[0.5 tsp]] salt, thyme and bay leaf.
Cook over low heat for 45 minutes, stirring now and then, until the onions are very soft and a deep golden jam. Remove thyme and bay leaf.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Oil a baking sheet and stretch the dough to fit, with a slight rim.
Spread the onions over the dough, then lay the anchovies in a crisscross pattern with an olive in each diamond.
Sprinkle with [[0.5 tsp]] pepper and drizzle [[2 tbsp]] olive oil. Bake 20 minutes until the crust is golden.
Cool 5 minutes, cut into squares, and serve warm or at room temperature.
Mix [[3 cups]] flour, [[0.33 cup]] sugar, [[2.25 tsp]] yeast and [[0.5 tsp]] salt in a large bowl.
Add [[6 tbsp]] softened butter, 2 eggs, [[2 tbsp]] orange blossom water, [[0.5 cup]] warm milk and [[1 tbsp]] orange zest. Stir to a soft dough.
Knead 10 minutes until smooth, then knead in [[1 tbsp]] anise seeds and [[0.5 cup]] chopped almonds.
Cover and let rise 1 hour 15 minutes until doubled.
Shape into a large oval on a lined baking sheet, flatten to 1 inch thick, and cut several slits to open into a leaf shape.
Cover and rest 30 minutes. Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Brush with the beaten egg and bake 22 minutes until deep golden. Cool on a rack and serve in pieces.
Boil 4 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water, then peel and slice.
Cut each roll in half and pull out a bit of the soft crumb. Rub the cut sides with the garlic clove.
Whisk [[0.25 cup]] olive oil, [[1 tbsp]] vinegar, [[0.5 tsp]] salt and [[0.5 tsp]] pepper. Brush it generously on both cut sides.
Layer tomato slices, tuna, egg slices, onion, olives and basil on the bottoms.
Close the sandwiches and wrap each tightly in plastic wrap.
Press under a heavy pan or plate and chill 30 minutes so the bread soaks up the juices.
Unwrap and cut in half to serve.
